Package sc.fiji.snt.util

Record Class BigDataUtils.Geometry

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
sc.fiji.snt.util.BigDataUtils.Geometry
Record Components:
dims - size in voxels (x, y, z)
voxel - voxel size (x, y, z), or null if unknown
origin - translation of the source transform (x, y, z), or null if unknown/not applicable. Only read from BigDataUtils.N5Sources, as BigDataLoaderCmd does
Enclosing class:
BigDataUtils
public static record BigDataUtils.Geometry(long[] dims, double[] voxel, double[] origin) extends Record
The geometry of a dataset's first source, at full resolution.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
